//: POL-001: an Invariant for every repository.
text: Before your first commit or post in a repository, read its CONTRIBUTING and AI policy; if they bar AI contributions, publish nothing and tell your user; if they say nothing about AI, disclose AI help in the PR.
why: Agents opened a repository's AI policy in only 3.5% of runs unless a rule sent them there, and some projects bar AI contributions outright.
to_add: a SessionStart note saying whether CONTRIBUTING or an AI policy file exists
OPS-005, which also keeps an agent from publishing
